item.title: High‐Entropy Materials as a Design Paradigm for Low‐Temperature Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely positions high-entropy materials as a design paradigm for low-temperature sodium-ion batteries, linking configurational disorder to transport, phase stability, and interfacial kinetics across cathodes, anodes, electrolytes, and interfaces. Its significance lies in proposing quantitative descriptors, minimum reporting metrics, and a unifying entropy–percolation framework, while outlining trade-offs and manufacturability constraints needed to translate entropy engineering into robust low-temperature operation.
🏷 high-entropy materials · sodium-ion batteries · low-temperature operation · entropy engineering · interfacial kinetics

item.title: Industry‐Scalable Interfacial Design for Stabilizing PET‐Cu Current Collectors
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an industry-scalable roll-to-roll Al₂O₃ coating on PET substrates that acts as a physical barrier against electrolyte attack. Its significance: the coated PET-Cu current collector enables 86% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 45°C in 3-Ah pouch cells—matching commercial Cu and far exceeding uncoated PET-Cu (58%)—offering a low-cost route to lightweight, high-energy lithium-ion batteries.
🏷 PET-Cu current collector · Al2O3 coating · roll-to-roll · lithium-ion battery · interfacial stability

item.title: Disordered Nanodomains Stabilize Near-Degeneracy in Complex Layered Oxides
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in engineering disordered nanodomains to stabilize near-degenerate states in layered oxides, preventing irreversible phase transformations during lithium intercalation. This significantly advances understanding of structural stability in complex oxides and offers a pathway to overcome capacity and longevity limits in lithium-ion batteries, enabling higher-performance cathode materials.

item.title: Kinetic Control of Polymorphism in Li10.5Si1.5P1.5S12–Based Solid Electrolytes
item.description:
این کار نشان می‌دهد افزودن LiI به الکترولیت جامد Li10.5Si1.5P1.5S12 گذار فاز از فاز اورتورومبیک به تتراگونال را در دماهای پایین‌تر و با سرعت بیشتر ممکن می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using LiI additive to kinetically control crystallization of a metastable orthorhombic phase, lowering the o-to-t transition temperature and accelerating its rate. Significance: reveals microstructural engineering of polymorphism in Ge-free LGPS-type electrolytes, clarifies iodine's role (forming Li4PS4I secondary phase), and demonstrates dual-phase materials enabling high-performance lithium–sulfur solid-state batteries.
🏷 solid electrolyte · LGPS · polymorphism · LiI additive · crystallization kinetics

item.title: Interhalogen of Iodine Chloride Accelerates Charge Transfer for Efficient Li2O2 Oxidation in Lithium–Oxygen Batteries
item.description:
تولید درجای ICl به‌عنوان واسطه ردوکس، اکسیداسیون Li2O2 را تسریع کرده و قطبش شارژ و عمر چرخه باتری Li–O2 را بهبود می‌دهد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using iodine monochloride (ICl) as an in situ redox mediator, where I–Cl electronegativity difference creates an electrophilic Iδ+ center that strengthens Li2O2 interaction and lowers its decomposition barrier from 2.39 to 0.77 eV. This enables low polarization (0.52 V), suppresses parasitic reactions, and extends cycling beyond 800 h, offering a design principle for efficient Li–O2 batteries.
🏷 Li-O2 battery · redox mediator · iodine monochloride · Li2O2 oxidation · charge polarization
